entries.title: Every call stops at getCompartment with Too many input arguments
entries.why: Line 58 calls getCompartment(model.mets,numChar); the only getCompartment (src/analysis/thermo/vonBertalanffy/getCompartment.m line 1) takes one input, so every call errors before any adjustment.

entries.title: Every call stops at getCompartment with Too many input arguments
entries.why: Line 153 calls getCompartment(model.mets,numChar) inside the unconditional 'if 1' block (line 142); getCompartment accepts one input, so every call that gets past the CO2 loop errors.

entries.title: An internal reaction with carbon dioxide stops with an index error
entries.why: Lines 106, 113 and 123 use model.mets(...) (a 1x1 cell) and then abbr(4:6), which indexes the cell, not the identifier; line 82 shows the intended char indexing.

entries.title: A Gibbs energy range with one bound at zero stops the call
entries.why: Lines 120-124 use strict inequalities, so DrGtMin = 0 < DrGtMax (or DrGtMin < 0 = DrGtMax) fits no category and the sanity check at line 135 raises the error at line 138 for a valid model.

entries.title: A confidence level outside the built-in table stops the call
entries.why: Line 68 gives an empty tValue for values not in lines 62-66 and line 167 then fails; confidenceLevel has no documentation (line 22), so other values are not documented inputs.

entries.title: The reaction labels read an undocumented legacy field model.rxn(k).directionality
entries.why: Lines 62 and 82 read model.rxn(...).directionality; the help (lines 9-13) documents only S, mets, rxns, so any documented model with one consumer or producer errors.

entries.title: The empty-producer branch labels the consumer axes
entries.why: Line 79 sets h1 (consumer axes) to NONE in the producer branch; h2 is meant (cf. line 59), and only a plot label is affected.

entries.title: Origin and destination compartments filter the result when unidirectionalBool is 0
entries.why: Lines 65-69 keep only reactions touching both given compartments when unidirectionalBool == 0, while the help (lines 17-18) says the compartments are only relevant for unidirectional; by the rule this contradicts the documented result.

notes: Judgment call: the branch at lines 65-69 is deliberate (comment 'invariant wrt direction'), so the likely fix is the help text rather than the code; under the campaign rule it is still wrong-result because the documented result differs on a valid call.

entries.title: A model with concMin or concMax fails unless concMinDefault and concMaxDefault are passed
entries.why: Lines 63-68 default concMin/concMax instead of concMinDefault/concMaxDefault, so line 188 (and 203) reads an unpassed argument ('Not enough input arguments'); passing [] hits the inverted error at 189.

entries.title: concMinDefault and concMaxDefault are ignored
entries.why: Lines 192 and 207 overwrite the inputs with 1e-5 and 1e-2 in the only branch where they would be used; lines 193-194 and 208-209 are unreachable.

entries.title: a model with the field R (gas constant) stops with an undefined variable
entries.why: Lines 58-60 define gasConstant only when model has no field R and nothing reads model.R, so line 118 fails for a model carrying R; extra fields are not excluded by the help.

notes: setupThermoModel (lines 92-99) removes R before its own call, so the crash needs a direct call with R present.

entries.title: Reconstructions with few stoichiometrically consistent rows are never reported
entries.why: Line 89 uses k (left at nReconstructions by line 75) instead of j and computes size(S,1)/nnz(SConsistentMetBool) (>= 1), so the < 0.9 test at line 90 never fires.

entries.title: Row rank deficiency of [F,R] and [Fb,Rb] is misreported
entries.why: Line 66 compares nnz(FRrows) with nnz(rankFR) (1 for any nonzero scalar rank) and line 75 'for k=nReconstructions' checks only the last model.

entries.title: The optional input modelMetaData cannot be omitted
entries.why: modelMetaData is listed under OPTIONAL INPUTS (line 18) but line 43 uses it without a default, so any call omitting it errors; omitting a documented optional input is a documented call that fails, i.e. error, not limitation.

notes: Quarantine already supported by the two wrong-result entries; the severity change does not alter the outcome.

entries.title: isSecondary is returned as a row vector, not m x 1
entries.why: Line 27 any(L(isInternal,:),1) returns 1 x m while OUTPUTS (line 18) documents an m x 1 vector; values are right but the shape differs from the documented result.

notes: Borderline: only the orientation is wrong; logical indexing by callers works either way.

entries.title: Every call stops because atomicNumbers.mat is missing
entries.why: Line 30 loads atomicNumbers.mat; no such file exists in the working tree and git show --stat 008e0e4f51 lists its deletion from conservedMoieties/.

entries.title: M is not the r x p matrix the documentation describes
entries.why: Lines 26 and 29 drop the electron column and reorder columns alphabetically before M is returned, so M is r x (p-1) in sorted order, not the documented r x p in input order (line 15).

entries.title: the default sanity checks stop when an atom transition has two instances
entries.why: Line 169 defaults sanityChecks to 1 (help line 51 says 0) and line 442 expands dATM.Edges.HeadAtom{mask} into a comma list, so strcmp gets too many inputs whenever an atom transition has two instances.

entries.title: the moiety index of a non-canonical component follows its atom order
entries.why: Lines 883-889 copy MoietyIndices of the first component position by position onto isomorphic components without using an isomorphism mapping, so a component whose nodes are ordered differently gets mismatched indices; the sanity check at 961 confirms the inconsistency.

notes: Entry 2 needs a dATM whose node order differs between isomorphic components; buildAtomTransitionMultigraph's ordering may usually hide it, but the help does not require any node order.

entries.title: minimalMassFraction is always 1
entries.why: Line 35 divides minimumMass by MMN.mol.Mass(ind(1)), which equals minimumMass by construction (lines 29-31), so the fraction is constant 1; the sibling representativeMolecule computes moietyMass/minimumMass.

entries.title: MMN.moi is required but not documented
entries.why: INPUT lists only .L and .mol (lines 12-13), but line 39 calls addvars(MMN.moi,...), so the documented input without .moi errors.

entries.title: with A empty and positivity = 1 the row count omits the x >= 0 rows
entries.why: Line 124 writes Drlt + clt with clt = 0 (A empty, lines 28-29) while lines 196-211 write Dclt positivity rows, so the declared row count is short.

entries.title: with A empty and inequality = 1 the column count is 1
entries.why: Line 260 writes clt + 1 = 1 even when only D is given, while lines 285-289 write Dclt + 1 entries per row.

entries.title: the linear objective f is malformed and placed where lrs ignores it
entries.why: Lines 79-81 print '0' with no trailing space and loop c = 2:clt (dropping f(1)); lines 233-235 likewise glue '0' to f(1); the documented f option cannot produce a valid lrs objective line.

entries.title: the shell script writes to a fixed personal folder
entries.why: Line 300 hard-codes /nas/rfleming/ as the output directory of the generated script, so the documented sh option yields a script that only works on one developer's cluster.

entries.title: rows with rational entries are dropped and become zero rays
entries.why: The '/' branch (lines 71-84) converts scannedLine (incorrectly: '1/2' -> 1.2 -> fix/mod = 5) but never assigns it to P(r,:), so the row stays zero and line 94 classifies it as a ray.

entries.title: the empty matrix P is printed to the command window
entries.why: Line 64 'P = sparse(nRows, nCols)' has no semicolon.

entries.title: a row with rational coefficients is read as a row of zeros
entries.why: The '/' branch (lines 163-176) never stores scannedLine into A(r,:); additionally line 106 has the '/' test inverted (sscanf '%d' on a rational row gives nCols = 1), which is why A is later resized by line 159.

entries.title: the optional param cannot be omitted
entries.why: Line 34 sets param.positivity instead of param.inequality, so line 43 reads a missing field for param omitted or struct().

entries.title: a row with rational coefficients is lost
entries.why: The '/' branch (lines 123-136) never stores the row, which therefore becomes an all-zero ray; line 157 removes it and line 159 indexes R with a sort permutation of the original length, so any rational row ends in an index error rather than a wrong value - a documented lrs input (rationals) that fails.

entries.title: a vertex whose coordinates sum to zero is removed
entries.why: Line 144 keeps vertices with sum(V,1) ~= 0, which drops e.g. (1,-1); the comment 'remove zero vertices' shows only the all-zero vertex is meant.

notes: Lines 157-159 also fail for any zero ray, not only rational rows.

entries.title: the optional param cannot be omitted
entries.why: Line 43 sets param.positivity instead of param.inequality, so line 87 errors when param is omitted or lacks inequality.

entries.title: with no equality and positivity = 1 the row count omits the x >= 0 rows
entries.why: Line 156 writes Drlt + clt with clt = 0 (no 'E' rows, lines 76-81) while Dclt positivity rows follow.

entries.title: with no equality and inequality = 1 the column count is 1
entries.why: Line 286 writes clt + 1 = 1 when A has no equality rows, while D rows have Dclt + 1 entries (lines 311-315).

entries.title: the shell-script option fails
entries.why: filenameSuffix (lines 323, 326) is never assigned in this file, so param.sh = 1 errors; line 326 also hard-codes /nas/rfleming/.

notes: Also noted (not an entry): help documents positivity and inequality defaults as (1) but lines 39-44 default positivity to 0.

entries.title: vertices are written as lrs linearities
entries.why: Lines 87-96 put the indices of vertexBool (vertices) into the 'linearity' line; in lrs V-format linearity marks lines (help line 21: a ray included in linearity), so the polyhedron is changed.

entries.title: the positivity rows are not counted
entries.why: Lines 101 and 124 count only nRay(+1) rows, but lines 138-150 append nMonomial extra rows when param.positivity is set.

entries.title: Edge weights are shifted when a metabolite lies off the cycle
entries.why: Line 66 filters inclusionOrder first and line 67 then builds the mask for A from the filtered list (shorter logical index), so A keeps its first entries instead of the matching ones; both stay filtered for later starting nodes.

entries.title: reaction nodes are removed from RBG with their node indices in dBTM
entries.why: reactionNodes (line 63) are indices into dBTM but line 105 removes them from the subgraph RBG, whose node numbering differs when dBTM has nodes outside the reacting components.

entries.title: sanityChecks = true raises an error for any class with two or more members
entries.why: Line 33 compares atom ids (Nodes.AtomIndex) with the subgraph index j, which fails for any real subgraph; the legacy code compared atoms2component(AtomIndex) with j.

entries.title: brandedFoods = true always raises an error
entries.why: Line 127 loops over 1:size(brandedNames.fdc_id) (a vector operand) and line 133 uses the undefined foodsnutrients (the table is foodNutrients, line 75), so the documented brandedFoods option cannot complete.

entries.title: The progress message has no space before the food source name
entries.why: Line 94 uses strcat, which strips trailing blanks of char arguments, giving 'forsr_legacy_food'.

entries.title: A whole-body model (struct) input is rejected
entries.why: Line 68 validates the required input with @iscell, so the documented struct input (line 9) fails parsing and the model branch at lines 98-111 is unreachable.

entries.title: addStarch fails for every food of the shipped USDA database
entries.why: Lines 222 and 231 look up Diet_EX_strch1[d]; the shipped papers/2025_nutritionToolbox/usdaDatabase/USDA2024_100gFluxValue.mat contains 'starch1200' and no 'strch1' (checked by byte search of the decompressed file), so the brace assignment fails.

entries.title: addStarch fails when a macro value of the food equals a looked-up nutrient id
entries.why: Line 272 (and 278, 285-301) index macrosSpef(macrosSpef == id, 2) with an n x 2 logical mask, which addresses the value column too; a value equal to the id puts a true beyond row n and errors.

entries.title: the food tables fdTable.mat and fdCategoriesTable.mat are not in the repository
entries.why: Lines 21-22 load fdTable.mat and fdCategoriesTable.mat; neither is tracked (git ls-files) nor present in the tree, so every call errors.

entries.title: Every call fails because fdTable.mat is not shipped
entries.why: Line 20 loads fdTable.mat, which does not exist in the repository.

entries.title: every non-transport reaction gets the exchange SBO term when any reaction is an exchange
entries.why: Lines 167 and 169 test strfind on the whole model.rxns instead of model.rxns{i}, so once any EX_ reaction exists every non-transport reaction gets SBO:0000628, overwriting the biomass term set at line 155.

entries.title: modelID without modelName stops the call
entries.why: Line 66 tests exist('modelID') before reading modelName at line 67; modelName is a documented optional input, so omitting it errors.

entries.title: The metabolite presence matrices keep entries of the compartment-free metabolite list
entries.why: Line 627 clears TableMets_male but not TableMetsNum_male, so line 646 only sets ones on top of the matrix filled at line 600 for the compartment-free list; the female section (1287/1337) is the same. TableMetsNum_* are documented outputs.

entries.title: The results file named in the help text is never written
entries.why: The help (lines 6-7) promises Results_StatsOrganComp.mat but the save is inside 'if 0' (lines 1508-1515); the documented output file is never produced.

notes: Entry 2 is borderline (a stale help sentence); entry 1 alone supports quarantine.

entries.title: ExclList is ignored for the blood exchanges of every organ but the kidney
entries.why: ExclList is used only at lines 425, 605 and 749; the general [bc] branch (lines 447-525) checks only its fixed BBB list (lines 467-482) before setting lb at 498/502.

notes: Even in the kidney branch ExclList reactions get ub = 0 (line 437) and a new lb (line 442), not unchanged bounds.

entries.title: ExclList is ignored for the blood exchanges of every organ but the kidney
entries.why: ExclList is used only at lines 376, 551 and 695; the [bc] branch (lines 398-472) checks only the fixed BBB list (lines 415-430).

notes: The function line names physiologicalConstraintsHMDBbased, not the file name (_old).

entries.title: Fields of a variable whose name ends with an input name are listed as fields of the input
entries.why: Line 71 builds pattern(inputName)+'.'+... with no left boundary, so 'model.' matches inside 'submodel.rxns'.

entries.title: Fields of the second and later outputs are missed when the reference starts a line
entries.why: Line 115 splits '[a, b]' into 'a' and ' b' without trimming, and line 131 searches for ' b.' so 'b.field' at the start of a line is missed.

entries.title: exRxnsOrdered = {} stops the call
entries.why: exchangeMetsL is assigned only inside 'if ~isempty(exRxnsOrdered)' (lines 66-82) but used by spy at line 85, so the documented '{} to skip reordering' errors.

entries.title: pre-Sierra macOS versions with a patch number or a one-digit minor select postSierra
entries.why: Line 20 uses str2double on the version string: '10.11.6' -> NaN (NaN < 10.12 is false) and '10.9' -> 10.9 > 10.12, so these pre-Sierra versions take the postSierra branch.

entries.title: An empty git listing returns the folder itself as a file
entries.why: strsplit(strtrim(''),'\n') at lines 98-99/113/117/120 gives {''}, which is not empty, so line 150 returns the folder path as a file.

entries.title: The default checkSubFolders omits subfolders in folders not under git
entries.why: Line 58 defaults checkSubFolders to '' (false in the if at line 102) while the help (line 22) documents default true, so rdir lists only the top level.

entries.title: Folders are listed as files in folders not under git
entries.why: Lines 107-108 (and 129-130) keep every rdir entry, folders included; the help says files are listed.

entries.title: needsLinux makes every test skip on Linux
entries.why: Line 177 compares computer('arch') with 'glnx64', which is not a MATLAB architecture name (64-bit Linux is 'glnxa64'), so needsLinux always adds the requirement error.

entries.title: A commit count that git cannot compute stops the function with an undefined variable instead of the intended warning
entries.why: commitsAheadBehindMaster/Develop are assigned only when rev-list succeeds (lines 57-58, 74-75) but read unconditionally at line 85, so the handling at lines 157-158 is never reached.

entries.title: only the first column of a 'G' row is negated
entries.why: Line 72 A2(G) = -A2(G) with an m x 1 logical uses linear indexing, negating only column 1 of the G rows, while line 73 negates the whole b entry.

entries.title: The default environment CPython3 rejects every Python newer than 3.8
entries.why: Line 120 accepts only versions containing '3.6', '3.7' or '3.8' and line 123 errors otherwise, so the default CPython3 option fails with any current Python supported by recent MATLAB releases.

notes: Environment-dependent: works only where python3 is 3.6-3.8.

entries.title: The empty input adds the current folder to the Python path
entries.why: exist('','dir') is 0, so line 63 turns '' into abspath('') (the current folder) and lines 67-69 insert it, contrary to the help (lines 15-17) that '' returns the path without updating it.

entries.title: A relative folder is added as given, not converted to an absolute path
entries.why: Line 62 converts only when exist(directory,'dir') ~= 7, i.e. never for an existing folder; the comment on line 61 states the intent to make relative paths absolute.

entries.title: MATLAB_too = true always raises an error
entries.why: Line 48 calls rnpath (misspelling of rmpath); no such function exists, so the documented MATLAB_too option errors.

notes: Severity could equally be unusable-option (documented option); both quarantine.

entries.title: A requested field without definition raises an error instead of being left out
entries.why: Lines 192-194 raise an error for undefined requested fields, while OUTPUTS (lines 21-23) say such fields are left out of the result.

entries.title: SpecificFields is ignored together with Descriptions or DataBaseFields
entries.why: The DataBaseFields and Descriptions branches return at lines 103 and 136, before the SpecificFields selection at lines 190-196, so the option has no effect in those modes.

notes: Entry 1 is an explicit, deliberate error; the help text may be the stale part, but by the rule a documented input fails.

entries.title: A file without metabolite lines stops with an error
entries.why: mets and metInfo are assigned only inside the 9-field branch (lines 29-43), so line 46 fails for a file with no compound lines; such a file is not a documented SimPheny compound file.

entries.title: Alternative names keep the blank that follows a '/'
entries.why: Line 38 splits on '/' and line 40 uses deblank, which strips trailing blanks only, so ' ATP' keeps its leading blank although the loop is meant to clean the names.

notes: Entry 2 is borderline between wrong-result and cosmetic; it is the only quarantining entry.
